headlines.title: ODFL Benefits From Disciplined Pricing Amid Weak Freight Demand
headlines.summary: Old Dominion's disciplined pricing, premium service and financial flexibility support earnings growth, while weak freight demand and rising costs pose challenges.

headlines.title: LTL survey: Old Dominion, Daylight Transport take home top honors again
headlines.summary: Old Dominion claimed the top national less-than-truckload carrier spot for the 17th consecutive year, while Daylight Transport captured overall honors for the third straight year, according to Mastio’s annual survey of LTL shippers. The post LTL survey: Old Dominion, Daylight Transport take home top honors again appeared first on FreightWaves.

headlines.title: LTL Shippers Select Old Dominion Freight Line as Top National LTL Carrier for Quality for 17 Consecutive Years
headlines.summary: THOMASVILLE, N.C., October 06, 2026--Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. (OD), a leading less-than-truckload (LTL) freight shipping company, has been selected as the #1 National LTL Carrier for Quality by Mastio & Company for a record-breaking 17th consecutive year.

headlines.title: Union Pacific Gears Up to Report Q3 Earnings: Is a Beat in Store?
headlines.summary: UNP gears up for Q3 earnings, with higher freight revenues and service demand fueling growth despite supply-chain challenges.

description: Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. operates as a less-than-truckload motor carrier in the United States and North America. The company offers regional, inter-regional, and national less-than-truckload services, as well as expedited transportation services. It also provides various value-added services, including container drayage, truckload brokerage, and supply chain consulting. In addition, the company operates fleet maintenance centers. As of December 31, 2025, it owned and operated 10,184 tractors, 30,824 linehaul trailers, and 14,313 pickup and delivery trailers. Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Thomasville, North Carolina.
